Its tail call 0x402ad1 tests byte [0x62599c] (cmp 0xff): that byte has no writer anywhere in the image (single reader 0x402ad3) and is 0xff, so 0x402ad1 always takes 0x402b4e, which loads the accumulated position dwords 0x638030/0x638034/0x638038 (RMW state of 0x401fed/0x4029d5/0x402a00/0x40e582/0x412e99/0x420c1f/0x424205..., zero in the image) into 0x402655 (eax/ebx/ecx, edx 0x20) and finally overwrites them: plain i32 state, the domain 0x402b4e itself was accepted with (globals=fuzz:i32). [0x62599c] keeps its image value (the 0x402ae0 branch is dead in the game) and the doubles 0x6f2a64 (2.0) and 0x6f2bdc (pi/2^31) are constants.
